name: EazyStock
description_en:
EazyStock is an inventory optimization layer connected to an existing ERP or business system. It uses inventory and demand history to calculate forecasts, safety stock, reorder points and order proposals.

The intended division of work is important: EazyStock supports planning decisions while the ERP remains part of transaction processing. It is a candidate for teams replacing replenishment spreadsheets, rather than a documented replacement for an entire warehouse or accounting system.
description_zh:
EazyStock 是连接现有 ERP 或业务系统的库存优化层，使用库存和需求历史计算预测、安全库存、再订货点和采购建议。

其职责分工很重要：EazyStock 支持计划决策，ERP 仍参与交易处理。适合希望替换补货表格的团队，现有资料不支持将其视为完整仓库或会计系统替代品。

core_features.explanation_en: The integration page describes importing master data, stock balances, lead times, costs and historical demand.
core_features.explanation_zh: 集成页描述导入主数据、库存余额、交期、成本及历史需求。

core_features.explanation_en: Daily recommendations consider demand, inventory policies, service targets, supplier constraints and calendars.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每日建议考虑需求、库存政策、服务目标、供应商约束及日历。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Approve proposals before returning orders to the ERP
sections.en: The documented sequence begins with supplier/item master data and historical sales or production demand from the ERP. EazyStock analyzes item demand profiles, then produces replenishment parameters and order proposals. Users can review all proposals or focus on exceptions; confirmed proposals are exported back for ERP editing or purchase-order release. Validate each direction of this data exchange with a small supplier set.
sections.zh: 文档流程从 ERP 的供应商与商品主数据、历史销售或生产需求开始。EazyStock 分析商品需求模式，生成补货参数和订单建议。用户可审核全部建议或聚焦例外，确认后回传 ERP 编辑或释放采购单。应以少量供应商验证双向数据交接。

sections.title_en: Model supplier calendars and uncertain demand
sections.title_zh: 建模供应商日历与不确定需求
sections.en: The replenishment page describes order calendars and dynamic safety stock/reorder calculations. An evaluation should include a supplier shutdown, an unexpectedly long lead time and a seasonal or promotional item. Compare recommendations with the planner’s assumptions before allowing regular low-value orders to run automatically. Vendor AI and stockout-reduction language is not an independently verified guarantee.
sections.zh: 补货页描述订货日历及动态安全库存、再订货计算。评估应加入供应商停工、交期异常延长和季节或促销商品。允许常规低值订单自动执行前，应比较建议与计划员假设。厂商 AI 和减少缺货的表述并非独立验证保证。

sections.title_en: Quote the planning scope and billing period
sections.title_zh: 明确计划范围与计费周期
sections.en: The official page offers a quote from a standard price list tailored to version, users, SKU quantities and expected ROI; no numeric subscription amount is displayed. It says annual billing is standard and monthly billing carries a 10% increase. Training, ongoing support, upgrades and a customer success manager are described as included. Confirm integration scope and commercial assumptions in the actual proposal.
sections.zh: 官方页从标准价目按版本、用户、SKU 数量及预期 ROI 询价，没有显示订阅金额。标准为年付，月付增加 10%。页面说明培训、持续支持、升级及客户成功经理包含在方案中；实际报价仍需确认集成范围和商务假设。

sections.title_en: Check the quality of the source ERP data
sections.title_zh: 检查 ERP 源数据质量
sections.en: Distributors and planners with many replenishment decisions can assess this specialist layer while retaining their ERP. It depends on usable identifiers, demand histories, stock balances and lead times. Missing sales caused by historical stockouts or distorted promotion history can change planning inputs. Data-cleansing rules, forecasting accuracy and failed-sync recovery were not tested.
sections.zh: 需要大量补货决策的经销商和计划员可在保留 ERP 的同时评估此专业层。它依赖可用标识、需求历史、库存余额与交期。历史缺货导致的销售缺失或促销历史失真会影响输入。数据清洗规则、预测准确性和同步失败恢复未测试。
